tokens.v: Catch his wrist at the bottom of the arm swing in fine rain, fingertips trailing a whisper of blur while the dial and soaked canvas strap stay locked sharp. Put him in a charcoal merino crew with the cuff pushed to mid-forearm, a black waxed-cotton raincoat sleeve above it, refined hands. 105mm at f/2.8, camera at hip height a stride behind, looking up the forearm. Rain beads stand on the crystal; The dial stays clean and unlettered, its painted indices and needle hands crisp, half-veiled by a sliding sky reflection across the crystal. A wet railing blurs across the bottom-left corner, cut by it.
